Name: Swizzy's Distillery (CFR)
Author: SwizzyStudios
Description:
[size=3]This mod will add in a new machine called the Distillery. [b]This is a purchase only machine from Gus for 5,000g.[/b] This new machine will allow the creation of new Alcoholic Beverages: Moonshine, Vodka, Tequila, and Whiskey. [/size]

[size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3241]SwizzyMeads[/url]﻿ Included [b](Place Honey into Distillery instead)[/b][/size]
[size=3]Includes Swizzy Meads only through the Distillery.  Due to limitations the words Honey and Wild still remain in the product name.[/size]﻿  Normal mead is created from Kegs.
[size=5]
New Alcoholic Beverages
[/size][size=3]These beverages are considered alcoholic and will provide the tipsy buff. These beverages can also be fermented to increase the quality by placing them into a cask.[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/K15qAp7.png[/img]

[size=5]Installation steps[/size][list=1]
[*]Download the mod from Here or from [url=https://github.com/SwizzyStudios/SV-SwizzysDistillery-CFR/releases/tag/1.0.0]GitHub Releases[/url]
[*]Unzip and place the SwizzysDistillery-CFR folder into the Stardew Valley Mods (Steam/steamApps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods)
[*]Start up Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[size=3]Stardew Valley 1.3.36 
Required Mods:[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url].
[/list][size=3]For [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url][size=3] users also Requires:[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991?tab=files]CFAutomate[/url]. Select it under the Optional Files.
[/list]
